WITH order_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders GROUP BY CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE)),
cal AS (SELECT cal_date, weekday_name FROM calendar WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-24' AND DATE '2026-01-01'),
od AS (SELECT order_day, n_orders FROM order_days WHERE order_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-24' AND DATE '2026-01-01')
SELECT COALESCE(c.cal_date, d.order_day) AS day, c.weekday_name, COALESCE(d.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM cal c
FULL OUTER JOIN od d ON d.order_day = c.cal_date

solver.query:
WITH od AS (
  SELECT CAST((order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
), cal AS (
  SELECT cal_date AS day, weekday_name
  FROM calendar
)
SELECT COALESCE(cal.day, od.day) AS day, cal.weekday_name, COALESCE(od.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM cal
FULL OUTER JOIN od ON od.day = cal.day
WHERE COALESCE(cal.day, od.day) >= DATE '2025-02-24' AND COALESCE(cal.day, od.day) <= DATE '2026-01-01'
